odd.why: The Big Five are lion, leopard, elephant, rhino and buffalo. The cheetah isn't one.
Naivasha is inland. The others are on the coast.
Jollof rice is West African. The others are Kenyan staples.
The Zulu are from South Africa. The others are Kenyan communities.
Victor Wanyama is a footballer. The others are runners.
Diamond Platnumz is from Tanzania. The others are Kenyan.
Raila Odinga was never president. The others were.
The Serengeti is in Tanzania. The others are Kenyan parks.
Malindi is on the coast. The others are around Mount Kenya.
Asante is plain Swahili for thank you. The others are Sheng.
